text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Having donned it once more,
it truly is a splendid attire.
choice_data_list: I believe this outfit exists solel...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Though there were quite a few twists and
turns before it was settled.

It all began when a council was convened
among the clan to discuss the design of Rose
Kingdom's racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—What I must wear is the long-cherished
ambition and pride of our clan.
What I must bring forth is victory and
glory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Expressing those qualities through our design
is paramount.
I pray every member of our clan keeps this
firmly in mind.

During the meeting,
Rose Kingdom stated her intent once more.
Naturally,
I understood her feelings all too well.
And yet—
choice_data_list: âWith all due respect, allow me ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, is it? What is the matter?
choice_data_list: I think having some different elem...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is something the matter?
You may speak.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—"My personal taste," was it?
I must confess,
I was taken somewhat aback earlier.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, that is fine—but as you know,
carrying the wishes of generations and
claiming victory is my true purpose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Mixing my own "preferences" into it—
to be frank,
is rather difficult for me to imagine.

It is true that the clan's long-cherished
ambition is momentous.
Yet—that single aspect is by no means all
that "Rose Kingdom" is.
choice_data_list: It might be good to take this oppo...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... Quite the difficult task they have set
for me.
Even when told to look within myself—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—Rose-san.
Thank you so much for the other day.
For helping me out with my Beautification
Committee duties.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No. The pleasure is mine.
...I only hope my clumsy efforts were not
a nuisance.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. You were admiring the flowers
with such sincerity—
and looking so happy doing so.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Was that so?
It felt quite novel, and pleasant besides.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me, my piece.
To let you be taken so helplessly...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Even in board games,
Her Majesty is as overdramatic as ever.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Though they may be mere pawns,
they are vassals who have entrusted me with
their fates.
It is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I like that.
Because you take games just as seriously,
competing against you is always a thrill.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Push the infantry formation forward...
and advance the cavalry along the left
flank.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
All right... How is that? This time,
I have struck at your headquarters.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now that's a rare expression from you.
Quite the smug look, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............A "smug face"?
What is that?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Literally a smug look, I suppose...
or rather,
a face brimming with the sheer joy
of pulling one over on someone?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. So my face, too, can harbor
this thing they call a 'smug look'?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer.
Regarding that matter... our racing silk,
that is.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Mm. Indeed...———

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............It really is nothing of any
consequence, but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............Just a little more...
fluttering, flowing movement would be ideal,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
When I helped tend to the flower bed,
I found
the flowers swaying in the breeze beautiful.
...That was all it was, however.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Bringing the proposal together afterward
proved to be quite a task,
but now...
I feel asserting my own will wasn't such a
bad thing after all.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh... But in that case,
one can't help but wish to peer into the
egos of others as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we tailor an outfit matching
this?
With a design incorporating your ideas,
naturally.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and Umamusume are two parts of a
whole.
They are meant to stand side by side,
are they not?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thus,
I wish for our outfits to match.
And to see your 'taste.' Surely this is a
thoroughly reasonable desire, is it not?
choice_data_list: Then while we're at it, let's do m...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A signature pose... That is novel.
Perhaps I will give that some thought as
well.
choice_data_list: (Whoa... Did she get into the groo...

text_block_list.text:
—In any event, witnessing a new,
delightful side of our master
is the supreme joy of those who serve her.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Those are words I ought to return to you—
the one who drew forth my true sense of
self.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps this, too, is a facet of myself
nurtured by this academy. ...Heh.
